shots.narration: At five twenty-five P.M. on November ninth, sixteen seventy-six, astronomers at the Paris Observatory aimed their telescopes at Jupiter. By the best tables on Earth, its innermost moon, Io, should have flashed out of shadow right then. Nothing happened.

shots.title: Thesis: Catching a Finite Beam
